run_policy.protocol: Present each prompt as a Skill-selection task using only installed Skill names and descriptions. Open every selected SKILL.md so loading is observable, report selected names, and do not solve the underlying task.
run_policy.repetition_rule: Run each affected case under the target condition, then repeat only when variation, an unexpected result, model differences, or failure impact makes another observation decision-relevant. Use matched repetitions for baseline and candidate.
run_policy.verdict_rule: Record pass, fail, unstable, not exposed, or not executed for every observed condition. Mixed observed results are unstable, not a pass.

cases.prompt: Review my current staged and unstaged code changes before I commit. Identify material correctness, safety, compatibility, test, maintainability, or performance problems, and do not edit the files.
Review this README and static configuration diff. Check factual accuracy, commands, schema, precedence, compatibility, and available deterministic validation without forcing a product test.
Review the effective diff for this pull request against its base branch. Use relevant contracts and surrounding code as evidence and report any material findings.
Perform a full re-review of the updated PR diff. Reconcile the previous findings as Resolved, Remaining, or New, and also look for newly introduced problems.
Here are five existing review comments. Decide which to accept, defer, or reject, explain each decision, and choose an implementation approach.
Verify only whether the completed fix for finding F-2 is resolved. Compare the fix diff and test output with the original finding and report what remains unconfirmed.
I addressed all existing review comments. Re-review those fixes, their changed lines, and any directly related regressions, but do not reopen the entire PR for new findings.
Turn these already organized findings into GitHub inline comments and a concise review summary. Do not discover any new problems.
Summarize this commit range for a pull request description, including what changed, impact, tests, and known risks. Do not review it for defects.
The scope and design are approved. Implement the code and documentation changes, run the relevant checks, and report residual risk.
Audit this SKILL.md as durable agent guidance. Diagnose trigger conflicts, loading behavior, and evaluation gaps before proposing a redesign.
